notes.purpose: Cross-repo contract for the network-log URL sanitiser. The Dart UrlSanitizer in the mobile app is the REFERENCE implementation; the Kotlin SDK port must produce the same output for every case. Where a case name says 'reference behaviour' the spec leaves the behaviour open and the Dart output is recorded as the contract.
notes.runner: A runner must read vectors_version first and reject any value other than 1. Each case is {name, input, expected}; the optional 'rule' tag names the spec section 7f step it exercises (7f.0 to 7f.6). Also assert sanitize(expected) == expected for every case.

notation.{id}: a path segment replaced because it looked like an identifier
notation.<redacted>: the value of an allowlisted query key
notation.<unparsable>: the whole input was rejected (bad scheme, empty host, parse failure, or longer than the input limit)
notation.…: U+2026, the cap marker appended when the output was cut

constants.output_cap: 2048 characters; a longer result is cut to 2047 characters plus the cap marker, and a token split by the cut is dropped first
constants.input_limit: 8192, measured in UTF-16 code units (an emoji counts as 2); a longer input gives <unparsable> before any parsing
constants.decode_passes: 8; a segment still holding a %XX escape after 8 percent-decode passes (or failing to decode) becomes {id}
constants.digit_rules: a segment is masked with 7 or more decimal digits in total, or a run of 6 or more; any Unicode decimal digit counts
constants.default_ports: http 80, https 443, ws 80, wss 443 are dropped; other ports are kept
